ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: What would happen to the elephant seal population if there were no whales?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: On the right side of the diagram there is elephant seal (elephant seal), and toward the upper middle there are smaller toothed whales (smaller toothed whales). There is a curved arrow from the direction of the elephant seal pointing to the smaller toothed whales, indicating that the smaller toothed whales prey on or consume the elephant seal. Then reason: If there were no whales (whales), the predation pressure on elephant seals would decrease, therefore the elephant seal population size would tend to increase.
